newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RBA to still produce quarterly reports on economy.
newsitem.headline: RBA to still produce quarterly reports on economy.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia said on Monday it would continue to produce quarterly reports on the economy, correcting earlier advice from a member of the RBA press office to Reuters that quarterly reports had been discontinued.

Quarterly reports on the economy were scheduled for the August and February issues of the RBA Bulletin, while the May and November issues would contain the bank's semi-annual statement on the conduct of monetary policy, the RBA said.
